name: projection-delta-applier
body: The component that applies a metadata mutation's node/edge delta to the projection (`apg/.trans/db.lbug`) in place, with no code re-scan. It covers both paths: the durable node/edge path (`apg.layers.write_project` → `apg.artifacts.reingest_layers`) and the transient plan/feedback path (`apg.plan_cmd.write_through` → `apg.artifacts.write_jsonl_and_reingest` → `apg.artifacts.reingest_project_with`). `apg.artifacts.ArtifactDb.detach_delete_project` (src/artifacts.rs:417-466) deletes exactly the passed FQN set with DETACH — the mutation's removed ∪ changed FQNs (`apg.artifacts.transient_delta` for the transient path; `apg.layers.projection_deletes` for the durable path), so a planned code FQN without a `<project>/` prefix is removed. The four Implementation labels are guarded with `AND n.status = 'planned'` (src/artifacts.rs:429-437, 448-463), so a scan-realized real code node and its incident edges survive; `UnresolvedTarget`/`Scan` are never touched. Covered by `artifacts::tests::planned_fqn_states_reflect_and_guard_realized_code`.
